yaml:
apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig
metadata:
  name: app-build
spec:
  runPolicy: Serial
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: https://git.example.com/team/app.git
      ref: main
  strategy:
    type: Docker
    dockerStrategy:
      dockerfilePath: Dockerfile
      pullSecret:
        name: registry-secret
  output:
    to:
      kind: DockerImage
      name: registry.example.com/team/app:latest
    pushSecret:
      name: registry-secret
  triggers:
    - type: ConfigChange
  successfulBuildsHistoryLimit: 2
  failedBuildsHistoryLimit: 1
